title: Mujrayi sheh ne kaha bhool na jaana zainab
body:
Mujrayi sheh ne kaha bhool na jaana zainab
Fateha bhai ka pani pe dilaana zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
rehem khaakar koi be rehem agar paani de
Pehle tum meri sakina ko pilaanz zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaid me chup ke chali jaaiyo sar ko nyodaaye
Apni aawaaz na ghairo ko sunaana zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Ran ko mai jaake na maidaan se phir aaunga
qaid tum hoke meri lash pe aana zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
mere lashe ko kafan gar na mayassar hoe
apni chaadar ka kafan humko banaana zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
gar sakina ka labe neher guzar ho jaaye
laash abbase dilaawar ki chupaana zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
haath se zaalimo ke koi kapda bach jaaye
nanhi si laash par asghar ke udhaana zainab
